north-yungas-road.title: North Yungas Road
north-yungas-road.slogan: La Paz to Coroico · one way, about 128 km back to the start

waypoints.name: La Paz
waypoints.advice: La Paz is where the day begins. Next is La Cumbre.

waypoints.name: La Cumbre
waypoints.advice: La Cumbre comes up 43 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Yolosa, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Yolosa
waypoints.advice: 85 km in you reach Yolosa. Next is Coroico.

waypoints.name: Coroico
waypoints.advice: Coroico closes the day.

sections.advice: La Paz → La Cumbre climbs about 4650 m in 24 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
La Cumbre → Yolosa drops about 4650 m over 44 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Yolosa → Coroico is 5 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

north-yungas-road.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road North Yungas Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: North Yungas Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4650 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: La Cumbre → Yolosa
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 4650 m come off over 77 km at around 10.6%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

scenicChapters.title: North Yungas Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 8 km this is North Yungas Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

north-yungas-road.story: 128 km from La Paz to Coroico, about 1 h 44 of riding. On the way it passes La Cumbre and Yolosa. The highest point is about 4,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: A-121 Ladoga and Sortavala
scenicChapters.narrative: 97 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 66 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-rempart-du-bourg-sacro-monte-calv.story: From Bellinzona it runs 257 km to Bellinzona; allow about 4 h 26 of riding. It goes by way of Isolino Virginia-Camilla-Isola di San Biag, Sacro Monte Calvario and back through Isolino Virginia-Camilla-Isola di San Biag. The highest point is about 1,850 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
